name: fantasy-epl
description: Personal Fantasy Premier League dashboard (Node/Express API + React client)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w app/server" "npm run dev -w app/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w app/server && npm run build -w app/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w app/server && npm run typecheck -w app/client
